records.jp: こういうベッドで寝てみたかったんですよね
records.en_original: I've always wanted to sleep in a bed like this.
records.en_auxiliary: I've always wanted to sleep in a bed like this.
records.en: I've always wanted to sleep in a bed like this.

records.jp: こういうベッドって……
records.en_original: A bed like this...?
records.en_auxiliary: A bed like this...?
records.en: A bed like this...?

records.jp: リゾートホテルみたいな？
records.en_original: You mean like the ones they have at resort hotels?
records.en_auxiliary: You mean like the ones they have at resort hotels?
records.en: You mean like the ones they have at resort hotels?

records.jp: はい。<CR>こんな風にお花が撒いてあるような
records.en_original: Yes, with flowers scattered on it like this.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, with flowers scattered on it like this.
records.en: Yes.<CR>With flowers scattered over it like this.

records.jp: いつかそういう素敵なホテルに泊まってみたいです
records.en_original: I'd like to stay at a hotel like that someday.
records.en_auxiliary: I'd like to stay at a hotel like that someday.
records.en: I'd like to stay at a hotel like that someday.

records.jp: まぁでも、ここもある意味リゾート地みたいな<CR>もんだよね。雰囲気は
records.en_original: Well if you think about it, this place is kind of like a resort.
records.en_auxiliary: Well if you think about it, this place is kind of like a resort.
records.en: Still, in terms of atmosphere,<CR>this place is almost like a resort in its own way.

records.jp: そう言われればそうですけど
records.en_original: I suppose it is.
records.en_auxiliary: I suppose it is.
records.en: I suppose it is.

records.jp: のんびりしてたって、別に悪いわけじゃないし
records.en_original: You can kick back and relax without having to worry about anything.
records.en_auxiliary: You can kick back and relax without having to worry about anything.
records.en: You can kick back and relax without having to worry about anything.

records.jp: それは……
records.en_original: Mm...
records.en_auxiliary: Mm...
records.en: Mm...

records.jp: 詩帆さんは頑張り屋だからさ、<CR>たまにはこういう所でのんびりしようよ
records.en_original: You're such a hard worker, Shiho. You should try and unwind every now and then.
records.en_auxiliary: You're such a hard worker, Shiho. You should try and unwind every now and then.
records.en: You're such a hard worker, Shiho-san.<CR>You should try and unwind every now and then.

records.jp: ……そうですね
records.en_original: ...Yes, you're right.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yes, you're right.
records.en: ...Yes, you're right.

records.jp: お姫様みたいな？
records.en_original: You mean like a princess's bed?
records.en_auxiliary: You mean like a princess's bed?
records.en: You mean like a princess's bed?

records.jp: はい……憧れちゃいます
records.en_original: Yes... I've always longed for a little luxury.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes... I've always longed for a little luxury.
records.en: Yes... I've always longed for a little luxury.

records.jp: 詩帆さんってさ、普段しっかりしてるけど<CR>時々ロマンチストだよね
records.en_original: You know, for someone who's usually so practical, you can be a bit of a romantic, Shiho.
records.en_auxiliary: You know, for someone who's usually so practical, you can be a bit of a romantic, Shiho.
records.en: You are usually so dependable, Shiho-san,<CR>but sometimes you are quite the romantic.

records.jp: そ、そんなことないです！
records.en_original: Th-that's not true!
records.en_auxiliary: Th-that's not true!
records.en: Th-that's not true!

records.jp: いや、悪い意味じゃなくて。<CR>詩帆さんのそういう話聞くの、楽しいよ
records.en_original: I didn't mean it in a bad way. I like seeing that side of you, Shiho.
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't mean it in a bad way. I like seeing that side of you, Shiho.
records.en: I didn't mean it in a bad way.<CR>I like seeing that side of you, Shiho-san.

records.jp: そ、そうですか？
records.en_original: Y-you do?
records.en_auxiliary: Y-you do?
records.en: Y-you do?

records.jp: お姫様ごっこでもする？
records.en_original: So, you wanna play princess?
records.en_auxiliary: So, you wanna play princess?
records.en: So, you wanna play princess?

records.jp: やっぱりバカにしてるじゃないですか！
records.en_original: I knew you were just making fun of me!
records.en_auxiliary: I knew you were just making fun of me!
records.en: I knew you were just making fun of me!

records.jp: 違うって。ふふっ
records.en_original: I'm not, I swear! Hehe.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not, I swear! Hehe.
records.en: I'm not, I swear! Hehe.

records.jp: （そろそろ寝ようかな）
records.en_original: (I should probably get to sleep.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I should probably get to sleep.)
records.en: (I should probably get to sleep.)

records.jp: あ、ごめん起こしちゃった？
records.en_original: Oh, sorry. Did I wake you?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, sorry. Did I wake you?
records.en: Oh, sorry. Did I wake you?

records.jp: いえ……
records.en_original: No...
records.en_auxiliary: No...
records.en: No...

records.jp: どうした？
records.en_original: What's wrong?
records.en_auxiliary: What's wrong?
records.en: What's wrong?

records.jp: 実は……さっき寝てたら怖い夢を見てしまって
records.en_original: Actually... I just had a bad dream.
records.en_auxiliary: Actually... I just had a bad dream.
records.en: Actually... I just had a bad dream.

records.jp: その……よかったら、手を握っていてもらえますか？
records.en_original: Do you think you could...hold my hand?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you think you could...hold my hand?
records.en: Um... if you do not mind, could you hold my hand?

records.jp: いいよ
records.en_original: Sure.
records.en_auxiliary: Sure.
records.en: Sure.

records.jp: ありがとうございます
records.en_original: Thank you.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you.
records.en: Thank you.

records.jp: ふふ、あったかい……
records.en_original: Hehe, it's warm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, it's warm...
records.en: Hehe, it's warm...

records.jp: 夏なのに、こんなことで安心するなんて<CR>不思議ですよね
records.en_original: Even though it's hot out, it still feels comforting. How funny...
records.en_auxiliary: Even though it's hot out, it still feels comforting. How funny...
records.en: It is strange that something like this comforts me<CR>even though it is summer, is it not?

records.jp: そ、そうだね
records.en_original: Y-yeah.
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yeah.
records.en: Y-yeah.

records.jp: （いいけど、なんか意識しちゃって眠れないな……）
records.en_original: (Now I feel too self-conscious to sleep...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Now I feel too self-conscious to sleep...)
records.en: (Now I feel too self-conscious to sleep...)

records.jp: 腕枕もいる？
records.en_original: Want to sleep in my arms instead?
records.en_auxiliary: Want to sleep in my arms instead?
records.en: Would you like my arm as a pillow too?

records.jp: それはいいです！
records.en_original: No thank you!
records.en_auxiliary: No thank you!
records.en: No thank you!

records.jp: 一度は体験してみたくない？
records.en_original: Haven't you ever wanted to try it?
records.en_auxiliary: Haven't you ever wanted to try it?
records.en: Haven't you ever wanted to try it?

records.jp: それは……いや、いいです！
records.en_original: Well... N-no, I'm good!
records.en_auxiliary: Well... N-no, I'm good!
records.en: Well... N-no, I'm good!

records.jp: （一瞬揺らいでたな）
records.en_original: (She wavered for a second there.)
records.en_auxiliary: (She wavered for a second there.)
records.en: (She wavered for a second there.)

records.jp: それにしても、眠るって不思議ですよね
records.en_original: When you think about it, sleep is such a strange phenomenon.
records.en_auxiliary: When you think about it, sleep is such a strange phenomenon.
records.en: When you think about it, sleep is such a strange phenomenon.

records.jp: どこが？
records.en_original: What's so strange about it?
records.en_auxiliary: What's so strange about it?
records.en: What's so strange about it?

records.jp: 眠っている時、わたしの意識はここにはない。<CR>実質、死んでいるみたいなものでしょう？
records.en_original: When I'm asleep, my consciousness goes somewhere else. It's essentially like I am dead, isn't it?
records.en_auxiliary: When I'm asleep, my consciousness goes somewhere else. It's essentially like I am dead, isn't it?
records.en: When I am asleep, my consciousness is not here.<CR>It is essentially as though I were dead, is it not?

records.jp: でも、起きたら戻ってくる
records.en_original: But when I wake up, it comes back.
records.en_auxiliary: But when I wake up, it comes back.
records.en: But when I wake up, it comes back.

records.jp: 時々、寝る前に思うんです。<CR>わたしはこのまま帰ってこれないんじゃないかって
records.en_original: Sometimes before I drift off to sleep, I wonder... What if I don't come back this time?
records.en_auxiliary: Sometimes before I drift off to sleep, I wonder... What if I don't come back this time?
records.en: Sometimes before I drift off to<CR>sleep, I wonder... What if I don't come back this time?

records.jp: 一緒に眠れば怖くない！
records.en_original: You won't be scared if we sleep together!
records.en_auxiliary: You won't be scared if we sleep together!
records.en: You won't be scared if we sleep together!

records.jp: そういう問題なんでしょうか……
records.en_original: I'm not sure that's the problem...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not sure that's the problem...
records.en: I'm not sure that's the problem...

records.jp: なんか一緒に寝てたら、意識がどっかいっちゃっても<CR>同じ場所に行ける気がしない？
records.en_original: If we're together, even if our consciousnesses go somewhere else, maybe they'd go to the same place.
records.en_auxiliary: If we're together, even if our consciousnesses go somewhere else, maybe they'd go to the same place.
records.en: If we sleep together, even if our consciousnesses go somewhere else,<CR>do you not feel they might go to the same place?

records.jp: 気持ちはわかります
records.en_original: I see what you mean.
records.en_auxiliary: I see what you mean.
records.en: I see what you mean.

records.jp: あ、そうだ！　同じ場所の写真を枕の下に入れてみる？
records.en_original: Oh, I know! Let's each put a picture of the same place under our pillows.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, I know! Let's each put a picture of the same place under our pillows.
records.en: Oh, I know! Let's each put a picture of the same place under our pillows.

records.jp: ふふっ、そういう方法もありましたね。<CR>実験してみましょうか
records.en_original: Hehe, I do remember hearing about something like that. Let's give it a try.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, I do remember hearing about something like that. Let's give it a try.
records.en: Hehe, there was a method like that too.<CR>Shall we experiment?

records.jp: よし、まずは場所選びだ！
records.en_original: Okay, first we need to choose a place!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay, first we need to choose a place!
records.en: Okay, first we need to choose a place!

records.jp: 私が見とく。<CR>詩帆さんが危なくなったら、私が叩き起こすから
records.en_original: I'll keep an eye on you. If it looks like you're in danger, I'll wake you up.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll keep an eye on you. If it looks like you're in danger, I'll wake you up.
records.en: I will watch over you.<CR>If you are in danger, I will shake you awake.

records.jp: それって見ているだけで分かるんですか？
records.en_original: Would you be able to tell just by looking at me?
records.en_auxiliary: Would you be able to tell just by looking at me?
records.en: Would you be able to tell just by looking at me?

records.jp: うーん……なんとなく？　雰囲気で
records.en_original: Umm... Sure. From your, uh, aura?
records.en_auxiliary: Umm... Sure. From your, uh, aura?
records.en: Umm... Sure. From your, uh, aura?

records.jp: それに、ずっと寝ないで起きていてもらうなんて<CR>申し訳ないです
records.en_original: Also, that would mean that you wouldn't be able to sleep. That wouldn't be fair to you.
records.en_auxiliary: Also, that would mean that you wouldn't be able to sleep. That wouldn't be fair to you.
records.en: Also, that would mean that you wouldn't be able to sleep. That<CR>wouldn't be fair to you.

records.jp: だいじょーぶ！　夜型だから！
records.en_original: Don't worry! I'm a night person anyway!
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry! I'm a night person anyway!
records.en: Don't worry! I'm a night person anyway!

records.jp: お疲れ様です。<CR>今度はわたしが見ておきますね
records.en_original: Thank you. I'll watch over you next time.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you. I'll watch over you next time.
records.en: Thank you. I'll<CR>watch over you next time.

records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
